explanation: Almost everything we know about it rests on its huge teeth, because a shark's skeleton is cartilage, which rarely fossilizes. Its exact size and shape are still debated.

claims.text: Megalodon (Otodus megalodon) was an extinct giant shark.
Megalodon was not a whale, a crocodile or a squid.
Megalodon is known mainly from fossil teeth, because shark skeletons are made of cartilage, which seldom fossilizes.
Megalodon's exact size and body shape are debated by scientists.
